description: Drafts domain names for a business, brand or project from a short description, checks each one, and returns only names that were free to register when checked: each with the reason it fits, price (first_year, renews, min_years, currency USD), confirmed, by and buy_url, a link to register that domain at a registrar. confirmed=false means very likely free and still being confirmed. Takes 10 to 20 seconds.

brief.description: What the business or project is, in a few words, such as "a yoga studio in Chiang Mai"

count.description: How many names, 6 when left out

name: suggest_names
title: Suggest available names
